newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi says does not intend to aid Nissan Life.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi says does not intend to aid Nissan Life.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Thursday that it does not intend to come to the aid of failed Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co.

A spokesman for Hitachi, which is a major client of the medium-sized insurer, said the electronics company is not in a position to bail out Nissan Mutual Life and has no intention of entering the insurance business in any way.
Hitachi rejected a request for assistance by a senior official of the Life Insurance Association of Japan during talks between the two on Wednesday, the spokesman said.
Hitachi and its employees are major Nissan Life policyholders.

The industry association has been serving as an interim caretaker for Nissan Life since the insurer was ordered by the Finance Ministry in late April to suspend a portion of its business due to massive debts.

The spokesman said that the insurance body official told Hitachi that the body has been working out a programme to set up a new company to take over Nissan Life's business but added that the official did not give further details.
Meanwhile, a Nissan Motor Co Ltd spokeswoman confirmed on Thursday that the company has no plans to support Nissan Life.
Nissan Motor is Nissan Life's second-largest client.
Sources in Japan's life insurance industry have said that the industry would ask Hitachi and Nissan Motor to bail out Nissan Life along with life insurers.
